arm5_misspecification.what: The gate doc registers ARM-5 as '(A_1, B_1) free, thresholds 2 to 4 held at identity' AND calls it 'the incumbent's own family'. Those are two DIFFERENT maps. recalibrate_bucket rescales the non-bust buckets PROPORTIONALLY (S'_k = S_k * S'_1 / S_1), it does not hold the upper cumulative logits fixed.
arm5_misspecification.consequence: ARM-5 as registered leaves the good+star mass literally unchanged from raw whenever S'_1 >= S_2, which is why its M5T equals the raw curve's exactly. ARM-5 is reported as registered; ARM-5b is the faithful incumbent-family refit and is the one the P7 question should have been asked of.

M1_is_degenerate.what: Pooled bust ECE over equal-width bins measures LEVEL, not discrimination. A predictor that emits one constant occupies one bin and its ECE collapses to |mean_p - base_rate|, which can be near zero. That is why ARM-4 and the permuted twin BEAT ARM-2 on M1 while losing badly on log score, Brier and the tier gap.
M1_is_degenerate.reading: compare `resolution`: ARM-4 and any permuted-collapse map have near-zero resolution by construction. M1 does not penalise that; log score and Brier do.

frame.note: PRIMARY is the NON-PROVISIONAL evaluable frame. recalibrate_bucket is a hard no-op on provisional rows, so every arm would emit an identical vector there and their only effect is to dilute all four arms by the same factor.

ordinality.claim: STRUCTURAL. The four PAVA fits cannot cross because the response vectors are pointwise ordered.
ordinality.reading: a POSITIVE value means two fitted curves crossed, which under pointwise-ordered responses can only mean the fit is wrong

H2_extrapolation.how_smoothed: carry the PAVA level at x_max, add the INCUMBENT curve's own log-odds increment from x_max to x. Exact at x_max, monotone in x, invents no shape the data cannot support.

H1_out_of_fold.how: idr_folds asserts set(train) & set(test) is empty for every fold, and train is restricted to decision_year strictly less than the test year, so no row can calibrate itself and no cohort can calibrate itself

lane_b_l5_idr_easyuq.four_arm_table_note: ONE table, every time. A zero-information constant scores UNC exactly and gets skill 0 by construction; that is the structural fix for the ECE regime in which a constant reached 152.68 percent of the candidate gain.

why_G3_failed_arithmetically.reading: the entire RPS gain, and MORE than all of it, is bought by removing miscalibration; the candidate PAYS discrimination for it. That is PAVA blocking: blocks are ties and ties are lost resolution. It is the same mechanism that killed X-ISO on rank, showing up here as a DSC debit rather than a Spearman debit.

pava_resolution_cost.reading: one level per threshold means the fold's PAVA collapsed to a constant and contributed no discrimination at all

forbidden_wiring_counterfactual.what: Spearman of E[WAR] under each arm against the realized target. This is NOT wired and MUST NOT be: it is the measurement of what the banned feedback would cost, and it is here so the next reader can see the size of the trap rather than rediscover it.
